import os,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1])/'cache-probe';native=Path(sys.argv[2])/'cache-probe'
with p.open('wb') as out: out.write(b'first');out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
assert p.read_bytes()==b'first'
before=native.stat()
with native.open('r+b') as out: out.write(b'other');out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
os.utime(native,ns=(before.st_atime_ns,before.st_mtime_ns))
assert p.read_bytes()==b'other', 'close-to-open returned stale data after equal-size/restored-mtime mutation'
p.unlink()

import os,sys,stat,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1])/'acl-probe'
p.write_bytes(b'private')
p.chmod(0o600)
assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o600
before=subprocess.check_output(['nfs4_getfacl',str(p)],text=True)
assert 'OWNER@' in before
subprocess.run(['nfs4_setfacl','-s','A::OWNER@:RWXdo,A:g:GROUP@:R,A::EVERYONE@:R',str(p)],check=True)
after=subprocess.check_output(['nfs4_getfacl',str(p)],text=True)
assert 'OWNER@' in after and 'GROUP@' in after and 'EVERYONE@' in after
assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o744
assert p.read_bytes()==b'private'
p.chmod(0o640)
assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o640
print(before,after,subprocess.check_output(['nfs4_getfacl',str(p)],text=True),sep=chr(10))
p.chmod(0o4755)
assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o4755
with p.open('ab') as out: out.write(b'changed');out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o755
d=p.parent/'mode-parent'
d.mkdir();d.chmod(0o3777)
sub=d/'sub';sub.mkdir()
assert stat.S_IMODE(sub.stat().st_mode)&0o2000
assert sub.stat().st_gid==d.stat().st_gid
sub.rmdir();d.rmdir()
p.unlink()
